Session.ConnectionFailed.source: Connection failed. Please try joining again.
Session.ConnectionFailed.zh-Hans: 连接失败，请重新尝试入服。

Session.ExperienceUnavailable.source: The game world is unavailable. Please try again later.
Session.ExperienceUnavailable.zh-Hans: 游戏世界暂时不可用，请稍后重试。

Session.CharacterInitializationFailed.source: Your character could not be initialized. Please try joining again.
Session.CharacterInitializationFailed.zh-Hans: 角色初始化失败，请重新尝试入服。

Session.ServerUnavailable.source: The game server is unavailable. Please try again later.
Session.ServerUnavailable.zh-Hans: 游戏服务器暂时不可用，请稍后重试。

Session.TicketRejected.source: Your entry ticket was rejected or expired. Select your character and join again.
Session.TicketRejected.zh-Hans: 入服票据被拒绝或已过期，请重新选择角色并入服。

Session.PersistenceLost.source: Your character session has ended. Join again to reload your saved progress.
Session.PersistenceLost.zh-Hans: 角色会话已结束，请重新入服以加载已保存的进度。

GamepadInputHint.source:
Left stick: move · Right stick: look
Y: target · A: attack · X: arcane bolt
View: inventory · Menu: settings
GamepadInputHint.zh-Hans:
左摇杆：移动 · 右摇杆：视角
Y：选择目标 · A：普通攻击 · X：奥术箭
View：背包 · Menu：设置

KeyboardInputHint.source:
WASD: move · Hold right mouse: look
Tab: target · 1: attack · 2: arcane bolt
I: inventory · P: settings
KeyboardInputHint.zh-Hans:
WASD：移动 · 按住鼠标右键：视角
Tab：选择目标 · 1：普通攻击 · 2：奥术箭
I：背包 · P：设置

UsernameTaken.source: That account name is already registered.

CharacterNameTaken.source: That character name is already in use.

AlreadyOnline.source: This account already has an active character. Exit that session first.
AlreadyOnline.zh-Hans: 该账号已有在线角色，请先退出当前会话。

CharacterLimit.source: This account has reached the character limit.
CharacterLimit.zh-Hans: 该账号的角色数量已达上限。

InvalidTicket.source: The join ticket expired or was already used. Request a new ticket.
InvalidTicket.zh-Hans: 入服票据已过期或已使用，请重新申请。

InvalidInput.source: Check the account name, password (12 or more characters), and character name.
InvalidInput.zh-Hans: 请检查账号名称、密码（至少 12 个字符）和角色名称。

Unauthorized.source: The account or password is incorrect, or your session expired. Sign in again.
Unauthorized.zh-Hans: 账号或密码不正确，或登录已过期，请重新登录。

Forbidden.source: You do not have permission to perform this operation.
Forbidden.zh-Hans: 你没有执行此操作的权限。

CharacterUnavailable.source: This character or service resource is unavailable.
CharacterUnavailable.zh-Hans: 该角色或服务资源不可用。

BackendUnavailable.source: The backend is unavailable. Check that the service and database are running.
BackendUnavailable.zh-Hans: 后端服务不可用，请检查服务与数据库是否正在运行。

SpellCooldownValue.zh-Hans: 奥术箭：冷却 {0} 秒 · 消耗 20 法力

InventoryEmpty.source: Your inventory is empty. Defeat a training target to earn a potion.
InventoryEmpty.zh-Hans: 背包为空。击败训练目标可获得药剂。

WaitingForCharacter.source: Waiting for the server to load your character…
WaitingForCharacter.zh-Hans: 正在等待服务器加载角色…

ChooseCharacter.source: Choose a character to enter the zone.

RequestingTicket.zh-Hans: 正在申请一次性入服票据…

PlayerDead.source: You died. Respawning at the checkpoint…
PlayerDead.zh-Hans: 你已死亡，正在检查点重生…

reviewPolicy: English source is frozen with its reviewed Chinese translation. C++ and gathered PO source must both match; review and update both fields when changing the source.
